answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 172252 Country: India Title: Praying in a Mosque Facing an Open Graveyard: Is It Permissible? Question: In our area we have a Qabrastan (graveyard) in front of the mosque and the windows are kept open while performing salah. Is it permissible? Answer ID: 172252 Posted on: Feb 26, 2025 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1192/1052/B=12/1440) Yes, it is permissible. However, it is better if you close the window while offering salah or hang some curtain or raise the wall of graveyard in front of the mosque high so that no grave is seen from there. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
